subject: POC environment activation roadmap — next steps & owners
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@acmetech.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmetech.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: POC environment activation roadmap — next steps & owners

Hi Marta / Samir —

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap + proposed owners for the MAP milestone that will unblock your POC: environment activation. I kept this focused on the dependencies we discussed so we can move to timelines once owners confirm.

Summary of technical dependencies (high-level):
- VPC peering / Private connectivity (required) — must create a peering connection to our staging VPC and route the subnets.
- IP allowlist / NAT egress rules — we need a short list of public egress IPs for metrics/telemetry and the admin API.
- SSO / SAML integration — enterprise sign-on using SAML 2.0 (IdP: Okta).
- Secrets / KMS access — customer-managed KMS key for secret wrap/unwrap and access to S3 artifacts.

Proposed owners:
- VPC peering: Samir (Acme network) + Priyom (Redwood infra)
- IP allowlist: Samir (Acme network) + Rishi (Redwood security)
- SSO/SAML: Marta (Acme IT / IdP) + Priyom (Redwood identity)
- Secrets / KMS: Marta (Acme cloud admin) + Rishi (Redwood security)

Target activation target: 2027-07-09 (provisioning + smoke tests) — tentative until owners confirm availability.

Attachments: I attached a short MAP spreadsheet (acme-poc-map-v1.xlsx) with the same rows + a sample network-config-snippet.txt for your network team.

Next steps (please):
1) Confirm owner names above or propose alternates by EOD Monday 6/28.
2) Samir: share the IP ranges you can allocate and whether peering requests need ticketing via your cloud team.
3) Marta: confirm Okta SAML contact and a test SAML metadata URL or cert.

If useful I'm happy to set a 30-min tech sync (Samir + Priyom + Rishi) to run through the peering steps and ROUTE tables.

Thanks —
Logan
Logan Wright
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@acmetech.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmetech.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC environment activation roadmap — next steps & owners

Thanks Logan — useful summary. A few clarifications from our side:

- Peering: we can open a peering request but it must go through our cloud platform ticketing system; Samir will raise the request Monday. We can provision the peering in ~3 business days after approval.
- IP allowlist: we can reserve 3 static egress IPs for you (public NAT). Samir will confirm the exact addresses and whether they can be applied to a CIDR /32.
- SAML: our Okta admin is me. I will share a SAML metadata URL and a test user by EOD Monday.
- KMS: we run keys in our AWS account and can create a key for Redwood to use; cloud security requires an access justification. I'll attach the internal KMS request template if needed.

We like the 7/9 activation target but request a slight cushion: can we plan for 7/11 as a hard smoke-test date to allow for ticketing delays?

Agree to the owners listed — Samir and I will drive the cloud-side tasks.

Marta
Marta Ruiz
Head of IT, AcmeTech
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>

Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: POC environment activation roadmap — next steps & owners

Rishi / Priyom —

Looping you in as owners for the Redwood side. Key asks for you both:

- Priyom: please prepare the peering acceptance instructions (CIDR ranges we expect, BGP options if needed, and route table changes). Send a short doc we can attach to Acme ticket.
- Rishi: review the KMS access pattern; we prefer CMK-key-wrap integration but we can accept envelope encryption if your security team requires. Also confirm telemetry egress ports (443 + 5222) and any additional IP allowlist guidance.

Timelines: Marta proposed a soft target of 7/11 for smoke tests. If we can have peering request created Monday and your peering acceptance doc ready by Tuesday 6/29, that keeps 7/11 reasonable.

I'll schedule a 30-min tech sync for Tue 6/29 10:00am PT. If that conflicts, flag availability.

— Logan

- Samir raised the peering ticket (Ticket ID: AT-8241) and attached your network-config-snippet.txt. Our platform estimates peering approval by Wed 6/30.
- Samir confirmed the three egress IPs: 54.210.33.10, 54.210.33.11, 54.210.33.12 (we can apply as /32).
- SAML: attaching the test metadata URL and a temporary test user we created (testuser@acmetech.com).

Next concrete asks for Redwood:
1) Priyom — upload the peering acceptance doc to our ticket (AT-8241) and paste steps we expect executed after peering is active.
2) Rishi — provide the KMS access justification text (2–3 sentences) and confirm the exact telemetry domains we will use.

We remain aligned to the 7/11 smoke-test target if the peering is approved Wed and you can act on the two items above.

Marta
